V01 Attribute binding and set logic
Failures stay in the denominator. Small family samples describe this bank, not general reliability.
General LLMs: reasoning OFF, 32-token option-ID ceiling. Decisions use typed choices.
Luna endpoints may use different checkpoints; this is not a same-weights serving-mode experiment.
